metric_definitions.ari_all_noise_as_one_cluster: Adjusted Rand index on all N rows; all -1 noise forms one cluster; higher is better, may be negative.
metric_definitions.nmi_all_noise_as_one_cluster: Arithmetic NMI on all N rows, with -1 as one cluster; higher is better.
metric_definitions.ari_covered: ARI only on rows with prediction != -1; null if fewer than 2; never compare without coverage.
metric_definitions.coverage: Assigned rows / all N rows; no noise reassignment; higher coverage alone does not imply quality.
metric_definitions.clusters_excluding_noise: Number of nonnegative cluster IDs, not a quality score.
metric_definitions.fit_predict_seconds: Wall seconds for adapter construction+fit_predict, including UMAP/JIT where incurred; includes algorithm lazy imports; excludes worker bootstrap imports, encoder, file loading, scoring. Fresh process per run, cache state recorded.
metric_definitions.cpu_seconds: Process CPU seconds over the same fit_predict region.
metric_definitions.process_peak_rss_bytes: Fresh worker process maximum RSS through scoring; includes imports and loaded arrays, not incremental method memory; bytes.

Needs prequential windows, order/time and frozen-vs-update controls; batch fit is not a streaming test.

notes: No global ranking across cohorts or information budgets.
Fixed presets are not tuned and do not establish each algorithm best achievable quality.
Same rows and matrices; KMeans arms receive oracle number of labels present in test.
Three seeds quantify initialization variability only, not sampling confidence intervals.
HDBSCAN is deterministic on these fixed inputs; its repeated seeds are timing repetitions.
Includes cold startup/JIT effects in fit region; prior process cache state may affect timings. Do not interpret as steady-state throughput.
